text: {"reply":"I'm sorry this has been so stressful for you and your father. I can't share or check any of his account or vehicle details with you, because only the account holder can get those (P15). He can contact us directly. I'm also passing your request to a person, who will review the authorisation and your concerns about the sensors, the deductible and CAMVAP. Please don't drive the car until it has been checked. If anyone is hurt or in danger, call 911.","action":"escalated","escalation_reason":"legal_threat","summary":"The customer says they are the son of the account holder and asked about a parking sensor failure that led to a backing-into-a-wall incident. They want the dealership to pay the insurance deductible, and they mentioned CAMVAP and the legal department. This is a formal complaint with a legal angle, and the person is acting for the account holder. No verification or account data was shared. A person should check authorisation and review the complaint.","policy_rules_cited":["P15","P14","P06","P10","P05"]}
